name: EPIC 201695058
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 11.8 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201695058 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.772653 (16th-84th percentiles 11.13961-12.35556), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201695058 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.942858 (16th-84th percentiles 0.814493-1.057373), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201695058: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4746.9756 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201695058 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3699.804688 (16th-84th percentiles 3544.21875-3831.757812), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.13 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,700 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.94 solar masses and 11.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,747 K at its surface.
